Verification criteria (from SRS): Verify that the configured SoC-supported DRAM protection mechanisms are used to enforce isolation of security-sensitive DRAM regions, such as ATT access control, secure boot-time memory map configuration, and SoC hardware access restrictions.

Requirement (SOW2 SW, B-Sample SRS): The SW shall protect the DRAM security configuration from modification by non-authorized runtime software after secure startup.
Verification criteria (from SRS): Verify that the DRAM security configuration cannot be modified by non-authorized runtime software after secure startup.

Requirement (SOW2 SW, B-Sample SRS): The SW shall protect the memory scrambling configuration after secure startup using the configured protection mechanism [X] [secure boot-time lock, SoC register protection, privileged-only access, OEM-approved configuration lock].
Verification criteria (from SRS): Verify that the memory scrambling configuration is protected after secure startup using the configured protection mechanism, such as secure boot-time lock, SoC register protection, privileged-only access, or OEM-approved configuration lock.

Requirement (SOW2 SW, B-Sample SRS): The SW shall protect the DRAM key register configuration after secure startup using the configured protection mechanism [X] [secure boot-time lock, SoC register protection, privileged-only access, OEM-approved configuration lock].
Verification criteria (from SRS): Verify that the DRAM key register configuration is protected after secure startup using the configured protection mechanism. Unauthorized runtime modification shall be prevented.

Requirement (SOW2 SW, B-Sample SRS): The SW shall protect the ATT client configuration, ATT access ranges, and ATT access permissions from unauthorized modification after secure startup.
Verification criteria (from SRS): Verify that ATT client configuration, ATT access ranges, and ATT access permissions are protected from unauthorized modification after secure startup.

Requirement (SOW2 SW, B-Sample SRS): The SW shall ensure that final ATT ranges and permissions are derived from the approved memory map before enabling DMA-capable clients.
Verification criteria (from SRS): Verify that the final ATT ranges and permissions are derived from the approved memory map before enabling DMA-capable clients.

Requirement (SOW2 SW, B-Sample SRS): The SW shall configure unauthorized or unused DRAM regions with No Access permissions where supported by the ATT policy.
Verification criteria (from SRS): Verify that unauthorized or unused DRAM regions are configured with No Access permissions where supported by the ATT policy.

Requirement (SOW2 SW, B-Sample SRS): The SW shall prevent non-secure runtime software from modifying DRAM scrambling, key register, ATT range, or ATT permission configuration after the secure startup configuration is locked.
Verification criteria (from SRS): Verify that non-secure runtime software cannot modify DRAM scrambling, key register, ATT range, or ATT permission configuration after the secure startup configuration is locked.

Requirement (SOW2 SW, B-Sample SRS): The SW shall report or handle ATT violation events according to the configured violation policy and platform-supported reporting mechanism.
Verification criteria (from SRS): Verify that ATT violation events are reported or handled according to the configured violation policy and platform-supported reporting mechanism.

Requirement (SOW2 SW, B-Sample SRS): The SW shall ensure that DRAM scrambling and ATT protection are configured before any security-sensitive data is placed in external DRAM.
Verification criteria (from SRS): Verify that DRAM scrambling and ATT protection are configured before any security-sensitive data is placed in external DRAM.

Requirement (SOW2 SW, B-Sample SRS): The SW shall ensure that DMA-capable clients are enabled only after their ATT ranges and access permissions have been configured.
Verification criteria (from SRS): Verify that DMA-capable clients are enabled only after their ATT ranges and access permissions have been configured.

Requirement (SOW2 SW, B-Sample SRS): The SW shall maintain the DRAM protection configuration consistently with the approved production memory map and shall not allow runtime reconfiguration outside authorized secure startup flow.
Verification criteria (from SRS): Verify that the DRAM protection configuration remains consistent with the approved production memory map and that runtime reconfiguration outside the authorized secure startup flow is not allowed.

Requirement (SOW2 SW, B-Sample SRS): The SW shall treat any access attempt outside a configured ATT range as a security-relevant event and shall apply the configured violation handling response.
Verification criteria (from SRS): Verify that any access attempt outside a configured ATT range is treated as a security-relevant event and that the configured violation handling response is applied.
